note: Pinned sources for the LGPL FFmpeg audio layer (ADR-067). A hash mismatch stops the build. FFmpeg's hash was also checked against the detached GPG signature of the release signing key with fingerprint FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8 on 2026-11-18. Opus's hash matches the vendor SHA256SUMS.txt (downloads.xiph.org). LAME 3.100 has no vendor checksum file; its hash is the one distributions have pinned for years and is recorded here as the trust anchor.
